statements.text: 1.1 The MoneyGram® online money transfer service (“Service”) is provided by MoneyGram International Limited (“we” or “us” or “MoneyGram”). MoneyGram is a limited liability company established in the United Kingdom with registered office at Third Floor, 30 Churchill Place, Canary Wharf, London, E14 5RE, United Kingdom (company registration no. 03287157).

1.2 MoneyGram is a payment institution authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority ("FCA") in the United Kingdom (Reference no. 502639 – see www.fca.org.uk/register) for the provision of money remittance services. Further, MoneyGram is licensed and regulated by HMRC as a money services business (MSB) under license Number 12552533.
